objects.name: Detection technique coverage: getcurrent-user-with-powershell-script-block
objects.description: The following analytic detects the execution of the `GetCurrent` method from the WindowsIdentity .NET class using PowerShell Script Block Logging (EventCode=4104). This method identifies the current Windows user. The detection leverages PowerShell script block logs to identify when this method is called.
